job.title: Construction Manager, Commercial Main Contractor
job.description:
We're working with a successful commercial construction business that's grown significantly over the past few years. With a strong pipeline of work, an experienced delivery team and a new leadership structure taking shape, they're looking for a Construction Manager to take ownership of construction delivery across the business.

This is a senior leadership position with genuine autonomy. You'll work directly with the Managing Director, alongside the Commercial Manager, and have the opportunity to influence how projects are delivered and how the business operates.

The foundations are already there. The business has good people, established client relationships and plenty of work. What it needs now is an experienced construction leader who can bring greater consistency, accountability and direction as it continues to grow.

You'll take overall responsibility for construction delivery across a varied portfolio of commercial projects, leading an experienced group of Project Managers.

Your role will include:

  • Overseeing construction delivery across multiple projects, maintaining a clear picture of programme, quality, risk and performance.
  • Leading and developing Project Managers, providing direction, challenging decisions and holding people accountable for outcomes.
  • Staying close to the construction process, bringing practical solutions to buildability, sequencing and delivery challenges.
  • Working with the Commercial Manager and QS team to understand project performance, identify risks and protect commercial outcomes.
  • Building strong relationships with clients, consultants and subcontractors, particularly when projects require difficult decisions.
  • Improving the consistency of construction processes, reporting and accountability as the business continues to grow.

You'll have the freedom to lead your area of the business, with the expectation that you can make sound decisions, resolve issues and keep projects moving without everything needing to come back to the MD.

What you'll bring
We're looking for someone with strong construction knowledge, sound judgement and the ability to get the best out of experienced people.

You'll have a solid background in commercial construction, ideally including projects in the $20m-plus range, and understand what it takes to deliver complex work successfully.

Just as importantly, you'll be comfortable leading people who know their jobs and have been used to working independently.

You'll need to be someone who:

  • Has the technical credibility to challenge experienced PMs on methodology, programme, buildability and delivery.
  • Can oversee several projects at once, recognising where to get involved and where to let people get on with their jobs.
  • Builds trust and respect while being comfortable setting expectations and addressing performance.
  • Understands the commercial implications of construction decisions and works effectively with commercial teams.
  • Brings a practical, approachable leadership style and enjoys helping people perform at their best.

You may already be working as a Construction Manager or Project Director, or you could be a strong Senior Project Manager with broader leadership experience who's ready to take on responsibility across a business.

Why consider this role?
The business is well established, has grown considerably and has a strong pipeline of commercial work. It's now putting the leadership structure in place to support that growth and improve how the construction operation runs.
You'll be part of a small senior leadership team, with direct access to the MD and the ability to influence decisions.

There's an experienced group of PMs to work with, a dedicated commercial function alongside you and the opportunity to introduce improvements that make a genuine difference to project delivery.

The culture is practical and relationship-driven. Leadership values autonomy, trusts people to do their jobs and wants to retain that approach as the business grows.

For someone who enjoys construction, leading people and having responsibility beyond an individual project, this offers a broader role with plenty of scope to contribute.

If you'd like to know more, apply directly or contact Ginny at RWR Construction for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Project Engineer
job.description:
About the Company:

Our client is an established and growing civil construction contractor with a strong reputation for delivering technically challenging projects across the Waikato and wider North Island.

With a diverse portfolio of civil and infrastructure work, the business has built a reputation for quality delivery, strong technical capability and a practical, hands-on approach to construction.

The company has experienced significant growth in recent years and has a healthy pipeline of work ahead, creating opportunities for experienced engineers looking to take on greater responsibility and develop their careers.
With a close-knit team and relatively flat management structure, employees are given the autonomy to make decisions, take ownership of their work and contribute directly to project outcomes.

The Opportunity:

 We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to join a well-established civil contractor delivering a range of complex infrastructure projects throughout the Waikato and surrounding regions.

Reporting to a Project Manager, you'll play a key role in coordinating construction activities, managing technical requirements and ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to a high standard.

This is a hands-on, site-based position offering plenty of variety, responsibility and the opportunity to work alongside an experienced delivery team.

Our client is particularly interested in engineers who have developed their experience within larger civil construction businesses and are now looking for an environment where they can have a greater impact.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the planning, coordination and delivery of civil and infrastructure projects.
  • Take ownership of allocated construction activities and work packages.
  • Coordinate site teams, supervisors, subcontractors and suppliers.
  • Review construction drawings, specifications and methodologies.
  • Assist with programming, resource planning, procurement and progress monitoring.
  • Manage quality assurance documentation, inspections and compliance requirements.
  • Identify technical challenges and develop practical solutions.
  • Monitor project costs, variations and commercial performance.
  • Maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants and project stakeholders.
  • Ensure health, safety and environmental standards are maintained throughout construction.

What's on Offer?

  • Competitive salary: $110,000–$130,000 depending on experience.
  • Company vehicle: Full personal use with fuel provided.
  • Career progression: Genuine opportunity to develop into Project Management.
  • Interesting projects: Work across a diverse range of technically challenging civil and infrastructure projects.
  • Strong pipeline: Join a growing contractor with plenty of work ahead.
  • Autonomy: Take ownership of your work without unnecessary layers of management.
  • Great team environment: Work alongside experienced, approachable people who value teamwork, accountability and getting the job done.

If you tick the above boxes & would like to find out more, apply today or reach out to Alex on 027 370 7011 or alexb@rwrconstruction.co.nz

job.title: Quantity Surveyor
job.description:
We're working with an established commercial contractor that's built a strong reputation for delivering quality projects and maintaining long-standing client relationships.

The business has grown considerably in recent years, creating an opportunity for an experienced Quantity Surveyor to join its commercial team. With new commercial leadership in place and a good mix of work ahead, there's scope to get involved in interesting projects and contribute to how the business operates.

The role
You'll work closely with the Commercial Manager, Project Managers and site teams, taking responsibility for the commercial management of projects from procurement through to final account.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing project budgets, cost reporting and forecasting.
  • Subcontractor procurement, negotiation and contract administration.
  • Managing variations, progress claims and final accounts.
  • Identifying commercial risks and working with project teams to resolve issues early.
  • Monitoring project performance and protecting margins.
  • Building strong relationships with subcontractors, consultants and clients.

It's a hands-on role where you'll be close to the projects and the people delivering them, with the opportunity to take real ownership of your work.
About you We're looking for someone with solid main contractor experience who understands the commercial realities of delivering construction projects.
You'll need to be comfortable managing procurement, contracts and project finances, with the confidence to work alongside experienced Project Managers and Site Managers.

Just as importantly, you'll be commercially astute, well organised and practical in your approach. Someone who can spot potential issues, have the right conversations and help find solutions rather than simply report on problems.
You don't necessarily need to come from a large contractor. Good construction knowledge, sound commercial judgement and the ability to build strong working relationships are what matter most.

Why consider it?
You'll be joining a privately owned construction business with ambitions to take on increasingly complex projects while retaining the culture and flexibility of a smaller contractor.

You'll have access to experienced leadership, a varied workload and the opportunity to contribute to a commercial function that's continuing to develop.
It's a good fit for someone who enjoys being involved in the detail of projects, values working closely with delivery teams and wants to have a genuine influence on commercial outcomes.

Interested?
Apply here, or contact Ginny Ryder at RWR Construction for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
The opportunity
We're working with an established Wellington commercial contractor looking to add an experienced Project Manager to its delivery team.

The business operates across a diverse range of commercial construction projects, including complex new builds, refurbishments and specialist building environments. They've built a strong reputation for delivery and have a solid pipeline of work ahead. As the business continues to develop, there's a real focus on strengthening project delivery, improving systems and ensuring the right people are in place to support the next stage of growth.

They're looking for a capable, organised Project Manager who can take ownership of their projects, work collaboratively with site teams and bring a practical, considered approach to construction.

The role
You'll take responsibility for managing projects from planning through to completion, ensuring they're delivered safely, efficiently and to a high standard.
Key responsibilities include:

  • Managing project programmes, resources and delivery milestones
  • Coordinating Site Managers, subcontractors, consultants and suppliers
  • Maintaining oversight of quality, health and safety and compliance
  • Identifying and managing project risks and resolving issues proactively
  • Working closely with the commercial team on budgets, procurement and variations
  • Building and maintaining positive client and stakeholder relationships
  • Ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the required standard

About you
We're looking for someone who understands construction, is well organised and knows how to bring people together to get a project delivered.
You'll ideally have:

  • Proven Project Management experience in commercial construction
  • Experience across commercial, multi-unit residential, architectural or technically complex building projects
  • Strong programming, planning and organisational skills
  • A sound understanding of construction methodology and buildability
  • Good knowledge of health and safety, quality and compliance requirements
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and communicate effectively
  • A practical, solutions-focused approach and a collaborative attitude

Experience in contract administration and financial management would be beneficial, but we're equally interested in strong delivery-focused Project Managers who bring the right attitude and capability.

Why consider it?
This is an opportunity to join a well-established construction business with an experienced team, a healthy pipeline of work and a genuine focus on delivering quality projects.

The business offers a good balance of structure and autonomy. There's an emphasis on accountability and good processes, but without the unnecessary layers often found in larger corporate environments.

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your projects, work with experienced construction professionals and contribute to a business that's continuing to invest in its people and operations.

Interested?
Apply now or contact Ginny Ryder at RWR Construction on 021 336 732 for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Project Manager

job.title: Senior Estimator
job.description:
The Opportunity:

We're partnering with an established New Zealand civil contractor looking for an experienced Civil Estimator to join its Auckland team.

This is a lean, commercially focused business delivering civil infrastructure projects across New Zealand, with work spanning earthworks, drainage, utilities, retaining structures, rail and general civil construction.

The contractor works alongside major Tier 1 organisations while also delivering its own projects as head contractor, predominantly using its own crews, with project values extending up to the $10M–$40M range.

They're looking for an estimator who can do more than price work — they want someone who understands how to win the right projects and deliver profitable outcomes.

The Role You'll be responsible for:

  • Pricing civil infrastructure projects across multiple disciplines.
  • Building detailed rates and estimates using Candy.
  • Reviewing drawings, specifications and tender documentation.
  • Identifying commercial, contractual and project risks.
  • Taking genuine ownership of tenders from start to finish.
  • Working closely with commercial, engineering and delivery teams.
  • Understanding project performance beyond tender award.
  • Helping the business secure profitable work.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5–10+ years' civil estimating experience.
  • Strong knowledge of the New Zealand civil construction market.
  • Broad experience across earthworks, drainage, utilities, retaining structures, rail and/or general civil works.
  • Strong commercial judgement alongside technical estimating capability.
  • Confidence interpreting drawings, specifications and contractual requirements.
  • Experience following projects from tender through delivery, claims and close-out.
  • A track record of understanding and protecting project margins.
  • Candy experience or strong experience with comparable estimating systems.

A Tier 1 civil contracting background would be highly regarded, particularly if you're looking to move away from a larger corporate structure and take greater ownership of your work.

Why Consider It?

 This is an opportunity to join a smaller, agile contractor where your contribution will be visible and your commercial judgement will matter.

You'll find:

  • Greater ownership and accountability.
  • Less corporate bureaucracy.
  • Broad exposure across civil disciplines.
  • A direct and commercially focused environment.
  • The opportunity to influence which projects the business pursues and wins.
  • Remuneration that can reflect the capability and value you bring.

They're not looking to simply fill a vacancy. The priority is finding an estimator with the right combination of technical capability, commercial thinking and attitude.

If you tick the above boxes and are keen to find out more, apply today or reach out to Alex on 027 370 7011 or alexb@rwrconstruction.co.nz

job.title: Quantity Surveyor
job.description:
Looking for more than just another Quantity Surveying role?


Our client is a well-established residential builder with an exciting pipeline of work and a reputation for delivering quality homes across the Northland. Due to continued growth, they're looking to add an experienced Quantity Surveyor to their team.

This is a broad role where you'll be involved from the early pricing stages through to project completion, working alongside experienced estimators, project managers and operational leaders on a diverse range of residential projects.

You'll play a key role in the commercial delivery of residential construction projects, with responsibilities including:

  • Preparing estimates and detailed cost plans.
  • Procurement and subcontractor engagement.
  • Producing purchase orders and managing budgets.
  • Contract administration and project cost control.
  • Managing variations and payment claims.
  • Supporting Project Managers throughout construction.
  • Liaising with clients, consultants, suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Contributing to value engineering and commercial decision-making.

About You.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Residential Quantity Surveying experience in New Zealand (group housing experience preferred).
  • Strong estimating and post-contract QS capability.
  • Excellent commercial judgement and attention to detail.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • A collaborative, solutions-focused approach.

What's on Offer?

  • Join a growing business with a strong pipeline of work.
  • Variety across first-home builds, architectural homes and multi-home developments.
  • Work alongside an experienced commercial and construction team.
  • Genuine opportunities to broaden your experience and contribute commercially.
  • Supportive leadership with ongoing mentoring and career development.
  • Competitive salary package based on experience.

If you're looking for a role that combines technical Quantity Surveying with genuine variety, experienced leadership and long-term career growth, we'd love to hear from you.
